My generator produced launch_us values exceeding 1e9 (base 10^9-10 plus offsets). Let me fix the generator to clamp launch_us to <= 1e9. Both implementations agree it's invalid, but I want valid fuzz cases. Let me fix.

Also note the run took 0.113s for 300 cases — that's suspiciously fast; it must have failed early on most... no wait, it printed 32 failures and finished. Actually most cases ran fine (only those with launch too big failed). Hmm, 300 cases in 0.1s? That seems fast but plausible for tiny graphs. Let me fix the generator and rerun.

import re

time python3 tmp/dev/fuzz.py 1000 500
